title: Instruction-Tuned Models Locally Produce More Syntactic Overlap -- But Not More Conditional Reuse -- Than Humans Do
abstract: arXiv:2607.26015v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Syntactic convergence - the tendency of speakers to adapt in language towards the grammatical profiles of their interlocutors - is a well-documented, largely implicit feature of human dialogue. Whether large language models exhibit analogous syntactic convergence towards human users relative to human baselines (including across a broad range of syntactic constructions) remains an open question. Using substitution-paradigm data from Blevins et al. [2026] in which model generations replace one speaker's turns in pre-existing human dialogues, this study measures turn-adjacent reuse of context-free grammar (CFG) rules across sixteen open-weight Llama and Gemma models (1B-70B, pretrained and instruction-tuned) at 1,901 matched positions per model. translated_title: 指令微调模型在局部产生比人类更多的句法重叠——但其条件性复用并未更多
translated_abstract: 句法趋同——即说话者在语言使用上向其对话者的语法特征靠拢的倾向——是人类对话中一个有充分记录且很大程度上是隐性的特征。大型语言模型相对于人类基线是否会对人类用户表现出类似的句法趋同（包括跨越广泛的句法结构）仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本研究利用Blevins等人[2026]的替换范式数据——其中模型生成的内容替换既有人类对话中一位说话者的发言——在十六个开放权重的Llama和Gemma模型（1B至70B，涵盖预训练与指令微调版本）上，测量了每个模型在1,901个匹配位置处相邻轮次间对上下文无关文法（CFG）规则的复用情况。所有模型与前一个人类轮次的CFG规则重叠程度都高于其与随机抽取的不相关人类启动语料的重叠程度（这是一种与上下文相关的效应，无法将句法启动与主题……分离开来）。（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该研究对16个开源Llama和Gemma模型在人类对话相邻轮次间的CFG规则复用进行测量，发现指令微调模型产生的局部句法重叠高于人类，但这只是与上下文相关的效应，其条件性句法复用并不比人类更多。
en_tdlr: Across sixteen open-weight Llama and Gemma models, instruction-tuned LLMs produce greater local syntactic (CFG-rule) overlap with adjacent human turns than humans do, but this context-associated effect does not reflect greater conditional reuse of syntactic structures.
